notes: The first official release of Streakboom. A round mochi-cat desktop pet for Windows: gestures (scratch, belly rub, poke, carry), mood and memory you control, optional AI brains (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI; bring your own key), opt-in stats with per-day counts, signed auto-update with fallbacks, and Peak's face as the app icon. Earlier 0.1.x builds were development builds and are withdrawn. The installer is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen will warn.
